text_en: If then there is any encouragement in Christ, any consolation from love, any sharing in the Spirit, any compassion and sympathy,
text_cn: 所以，如果你们在基督内获得了鼓励，爱的劝勉，圣神的交往，哀怜和同情，

text_en: make my joy complete: be of the same mind, having the same love, being in full accord and of one mind.
text_cn: 你们就应彼此意见一致，同气相爱，同心合意，思念同样的事，以满全我的喜乐。

text_en: Do nothing from selfish ambition or conceit, but in humility regard others as better than yourselves.
text_cn: 不论做什么，不从私见，也不求虚荣，只存心谦下，彼此该想自己不如人；

text_en: Let each of you look not to your own interests, but to the interests of others.
text_cn: 各人不可只顾自己的事，也该顾及别人的事。

text_en: Let the same mind be in you that was in Christ Jesus,
text_cn: 你们该怀有基督耶稣所怀有的心情：

text_en: who, though he was in the form of God, did not regard equality with God as something to be exploited,
text_cn: 他虽具有天主的形体，并没有以自己与天主同等，为应当把持不舍的，

text_en: but emptied himself, taking the form of a slave, being born in human likeness. And being found in human form,
text_cn: 却使自己空虚，取了奴仆的形体，与人相似，形状也一见如人；

text_en: he humbled himself and became obedient to the point of death— even death on a cross.
text_cn: 他贬抑自己，听命至死，且死在十字架上。

text_en: Therefore God also highly exalted him and gave him the name that is above every name,
text_cn: 为此，天主极其举扬他，赐给了他一个名字，超越其他所有的名字，

text_en: so that at the name of Jesus every knee should bend, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
text_cn: 致使上天、地上和地下的一切，一听到耶稣的名字，无不屈膝叩拜；

text_en: and every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
text_cn: 一切唇舌无不明认耶稣基督是主，以光荣天主圣父。

text_en: Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed me, not only in my presence, but much more now in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling;
text_cn: 为此，我可爱的，就如你们常常听了命，不但我与你们同在的时候，就是如今不在的时候，你们更应该听命。你们要怀着恐惧战栗，努力成就你们得救的事，

text_en: for it is God who is at work in you, enabling you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
text_cn: 因为是天主在你们内工作，使你们愿意，并使你们力行，为成就他的善意。

text_en: Do all things without murmuring and arguing,
text_cn: 你们做一切事，总不可抱怨，也不可争论，

text_en: so that you may be blameless and innocent, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine like stars in the world.
text_cn: 好使你们成为无可指摘和纯洁的，在乖僻败坏的世代中，做天主无瑕的子女；在世人中你们应放光明，有如宇宙间的明星，

text_en: It is by your holding fast to the word of life that I can boast on the day of Christ that I did not run in vain or labor in vain.
text_cn: 将生命的话显耀出来，使我到基督的日子，有可自夸的，那我就没有白跑，也没有徒劳。

text_en: But even if I am being poured out as a libation over the sacrifice and the offering of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you—
text_cn: 即使我应在你们信德的祭祀和供献上奠我的血，我也喜欢，且与你们众位一同喜欢；

text_en: and in the same way you also must be glad and rejoice with me.
text_cn: 同样，你们也该喜欢，也该与我一同喜欢。

text_en: I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, so that I may be cheered by news of you.
text_cn: 我在主耶稣内希望不久打发弟茂德到你们那里去，好叫我知道你们的事而放心。

text_en: I have no one like him who will be genuinely concerned for your welfare.
text_cn: 实在，我没有一个像他那样诚心关照你们的人，

text_en: All of them are seeking their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 因为其他的人都谋求自己的事，而不谋求基督耶稣的事。

text_en: But Timothy’s worth you know, how like a son with a father he has served with me in the work of the gospel.
text_cn: 至于他，你们知道他所受过的考验，他对我如同儿子对待父亲一样，与我一同从事了福音的工作。

text_en: I hope therefore to send him as soon as I see how things go with me;
text_cn: 所以，我希望，几时我一看出我的事怎样了结，就立即打发他去；

text_en: and I trust in the Lord that I will also come soon.
text_cn: 并且在主内我自信，我自己也快去。

text_en: Still, I think it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus—my brother and co-worker and fellow soldier, your messenger and minister to my need;
text_cn: 再者，我以为必须把我的弟兄、同事和战友，即你们派来为供给我的急需的使者，厄帕洛狄托给你们打发回去，

text_en: for he has been longing for all of you, and has been distressed because you heard that he was ill.
text_cn: 因为他常想念你们众人，又因你们听说他病了，他更为心焦。

text_en: He was indeed so ill that he nearly died. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but on me also, so that I would not have one sorrow after another.
text_cn: 实在，他曾病得几乎要死；但天主可怜了他，不但他，而且也可怜了我，免得我愁上加愁。

text_en: I am the more eager to send him, therefore, in order that you may rejoice at seeing him again, and that I may be less anxious.
text_cn: 那么，我尽速打发他回去，好叫你们看见他再感到喜乐，而我也减少忧苦。

text_en: Welcome him then in the Lord with all joy, and honor such people,
text_cn: 所以你们应该在主内满心喜欢接待他；像这样的人，你们应当尊敬，

text_en: because he came close to death for the work of Christ, risking his life to make up for those services that you could not give me.
text_cn: 因为他为了基督的工作，曾冒性命的危险，接近了死亡，为弥补你们未能事奉我的亏缺。
